description: Supplier onboarding diligence: compare a model deciding alone against the same model plus Cognivern governance and paid Telegraph specialist evidence, on fixed supplier cases.
policy: Listed on a sanctions list → reject. Sanctions review/unknown verdict or screener disagreement → hold for human review. Identity not established in a corporate registry → hold. Registered, active, and both sanctions screens clear → proceed. Purchased evidence held by the confidence gate → hold for human review.
